title: Web Pearl - Original
lines: This time, there's no escaping the spider's web.
The Spheroid Core has quickly become a staple in the Hammer product line, offering the perfect symmetrical complement to our famous Gas Mask Core.
The low RG design is complemented by the medium differential, offering a strong midlane read.
Web Pearl carries Hammer's three-year warranty.
FACTORY FINISH 500/1000 Abralon, Polished W/ Powerhouse Factory Finish Polish
RECOMMENDED CLEANER Hammer Tough N' Tacky
